Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000248": The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000438" [decision]: Ledger service migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000221": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000454": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000107" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000145": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000195" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000087": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000373": The authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: authentication gateway, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000434": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011, the schema migration)
- memory_id "1000548" [constraint]: Per policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000377": The Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate rise and pinged the authentication gateway's owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000215" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000212" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000171" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
Existing entity names: ledger service, INC-2025-011, auth gateway, the cache change, Lena, billing API, Oskar, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, reporting service, notifier, authentication gateway, the dependency bump, the schema migration, Boreal team, push provider
